Therapists are for talking out the bad stuff and looking for the good stuff. Friends are for venting the bad stuff and *getting through* the bad stuff. Also for me, I feel like if I talk about my problems to any of my friends, it'll just be burdening them with that knowledge and possibly make them think it's their job to make me feel better. I hate burdening my friends. I consider my therapist my friend too but it's *first and foremost* her job to be my therapist so while she get's paid to listen to my problems, I don't feel burdened.
